pages.text: The vanguard of the serpon combat team, heralding the team's arrival - holding the line and clearing the road for you, and returning to the ranks once the fight is over.

You can summon this pioneer by ritual, or call more of them onto the field with a $(l:supreme/items/serpon_head_focus)Serpon Head Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Serpon Pioneer with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
